additional_info.subject: NOTE TO CCC
additional_info.body:
Connector 1 (Chademo) remained in the "charging failed" status even though no vehicle was connected. The incident was observed on 10/10/2025 at 7:42 PM.
Also, the display shows a power of 300kW instead of 60kW.
Can this be changed please?

additional_info.subject: ID0455616-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP/P8 170000833] Charging fail status CRM:03056000184
additional_info.body:
Hello Nicolas, good morning.
I see that you mention that it was stuck on the 10/Oct at 7:42pm but I couldn't find anything from the previous 3h.
Is it possible to check via backend when this first occurred?
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0455616-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP/P8 170000833] Charging fail status CRM:03056000184

We will change the 300kW to 60kW as soon as DC2 stops charging, you will see in the backend that the outlets went unavailable for a few seconds.
Thanks!
